page_title: MCI 2-0 SHU | Manchester City v Sheffield Utd 30/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, David Coote has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90' Substitution. Rhys Norrington-Davies (Sheffield Utd) has come on for Luke Thomas.
89' David Coote shows a yellow card to Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) for a tough tackle.
87' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
86' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

86' Phil Foden (Manchester City) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
84' Rodri (Manchester City) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
82' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
80' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. Andre Brooks is replaced by Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd).
73' Manchester City are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
69' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) prepares to take a corner kick.
68' Substitution. Ruben Dias (Manchester City) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mateo Kovacic walks off.
68' That's the end of the game for Kyle Walker, who is replaced by Rico Lewis (Manchester City).
67' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) replacing Anis Ben Slimane.
67' It's time for a substitution. Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) comes on in place of William Osula.
65' Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
61' 2 - 0 Goal! Phil Foden puts the ball on a plate for Julian Alvarez (Manchester City), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:0.
61' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes it short.
58' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) works the corner short.

57' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Phil Foden (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Rodri (Manchester City) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
56' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
55' Phil Foden (Manchester City) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
53' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to find Oscar Bobb with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
52' Substitution. Jack Grealish will be replaced by Oscar Bobb (Manchester City).
51' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

50' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.
49' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) is adjudged offside.
47' Rodri (Manchester City) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' David Coote blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Ederson easily catches the ball.
45' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
43' David Coote shows the yellow card to Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) for a heavy challenge.
42' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

41' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy. The linesman makes the right call and Sheffield Utd will have a corner.
40' Half-chance! Jack Grealish (Manchester City) plays a pass into the box, but Wesley Foderingham reacts well to snuff out the attack.

40' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) was too forceful with his tackle and David Coote interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Sheffield Utd are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
38' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
35' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
35' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
34' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) brings his opponent down. David Coote has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Manchester City.
33' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) takes a short corner kick.
32' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Now Manchester City have a corner.
31' It looks like Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) saw red with that tackle. David Coote won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
29' Rodri (Manchester City) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar.
28' The referee awards a corner and Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) goes over to take it.
24' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
24' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
23' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Manchester City earn a corner.
22' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
21' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
19' Rodri (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

16' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
14' 1 - 0 Rodri (Manchester City) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
14' The game is interrupted as William Osula (Sheffield Utd) is flagged offside.
13' George Baldock (Sheffield Utd) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
12' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
9' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sheffield Utd.
6' Manchester City are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

4' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Ederson!
3' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
1' The match has just started.
Sheffield Utd will kick the game off.
David Coote will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
